title: Michael Shayne
paragraphs: Radio adventures featuring Brett Halliday's private detective Michael Shayne, following the tough investigator through murder, blackmail, disappearances, and other criminal cases across several radio productions.
Mixed-incarnation Michael Shayne radio archive. Dates and numbering are interpreted within each production layer, not as one continuous series sequence.

The run breaks into several distinct periods: Mutual / Wally Maher incarnation (October 16, 1944 to November 14, 1947) on [[org|org.09b709d4bde5c263|Mutual Broadcasting System]], Jeff Chandler Broadcasters Guild syndication (1948), and ABC revival (October 14, 1952 to July 10, 1953) on [[org|org.0d7b5c86680811cc|ABC Radio Network]].

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include William P. Rousseau (director), Don W. Sharpe (producer), [[person|jeff-chandler|Jeff Chandler]] (performer), John Duffy (music, composer, and conductor), Brett Halliday (creator), Cathy Lewis (performer), and Wally Maher (performer).

Across its run, the surviving broadcasts are tied to [[org|org.0d7b5c86680811cc|ABC Radio Network]], [[org|org.4798d1172deaae2c|Armed Forces Radio Service]], [[org|org.09b709d4bde5c263|Mutual Broadcasting System]], and [[org|org.070a5b7dde24b155|Ziv]].

The stories often return to private detective investigation, hard-boiled/noir crime atmosphere, New Orleans setting in the Jeff Chandler incarnation, murder and homicide, blackmail, fraud and coercion, and guns, violence and physical clues.

The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes Popular literary detective franchise moves through radio incarnations, Postwar transcribed detective syndication, Postwar hard-boiled crime and noir radio, and Network-to-syndication-to-network production shifts.

If you are following the same actors and creative circles, related programs worth opening next include [[show|the-whistler|The Whistler]], [[show|escape|Escape]], [[show|suspense|Suspense]], [[show|jeff-regan-investigator|Jeff Regan, Investigator]], and [[show|let-george-do-it|Let George Do It]].
